summary: 2026-09-21: All 11 Firestore/Storage emulator tests pass. Private collections and owner-only roster are denied to unauthorized clients; feature-scoped storage writes, MIME/size limits, draft filtering and content schema create/update checks are tested. AWS authorization, audit and intake regressions are covered separately in the 82-test application suite. This is a targeted engineering review, not certification.

findings.issue: Content collections now enforce top-level keys, primitive types and size limits, but nested product/article lists and the flexible siteContent/siteTheme documents do not have exhaustive per-field rule schemas. Authorized content editors can still damage content within their assigned area; these permissions cannot grant patient or role access.
findings.recommendation: Version the flexible content documents before introducing exhaustive nested rules; preserve the tested feature boundaries and client content decoding.
